summary: Fed's first rate hike since 2023 under Warsh (one more signaled) triggered a broad selloff — Dow -1.21%, SPX -0.45% — with a breadth washout (149 new 20day lows, T2108 25.6%), RUT to Bearish and DJI to Neutral Bear. Capital rotated into healthcare and power; energy E&P and banks led the damage.
